notes: Version: final MT1 (v2.x incl. The Last Divinity DLC). Enemy list = wiki Lua module Module:Enemies/Data (stats per Covenant rank, ability text, Pact-Shard ★ variant). category: flying_boss = the wiki's 'Major Boss' (Rings 3/6/8 + The Last Divinity, Ring 9), boss = minor ring boss, normal = the wiki's 'Heavy' or 'Support' wave enemy (extra.native_type keeps which), minion = only spawned by a boss (Constructed Explosive by Daedalus, Darkshards by Archus), special = Collector (gold bounty). hp.base/attack = covenant 0 row; hp.covenant lists every row ('cov N+: attack/health'); 'AxN' attack = A damage hitting N times (extra.attack_display). size: not documented on the MT1 wiki (null). pattern = generic behaviour of the category (from the wiki 'Battle' page) + the boss variant battle effects + the enemy page's lead text. waves = combat page wave tables (both covenant columns merged). extra.pact_shard_variant = the ★ version the game swaps in as Pact Shards accumulate (shard_cost = shards spent per upgraded enemy). Completeness: Module:Enemies/Data 56 entries vs Category:Enemies 56 pages -> category-only none, module-only none | Major Boss: module 6 / Category:Major Boss Enemies 6 | Boss: module 13 / Category:Boss Enemies 13 | Heavy: module 15 / Category:Heavy Enemies 15 | Support: module 22 / Category:Support Enemies 22 | combat pages parsed 38 (Category:Combats 37 + Divine Intervention); wave-table names not in the enemy module: none | enemies never listed in a wave table: ['Alabaster Guardian', 'Blinding Darkshard', 'Collector', 'Constructed Explosive', 'Looming Darkshard', 'Shattering Darkshard'] (summoned by bosses or special spawns)

enemies.name: Daedalus, the Professor
enemies.pattern: Major boss: starts 'flying' beside one floor, moves to a different floor every turn and can be hit there by units/spells (always behind other enemies, cannot be moved within the floor, can be Ascended/Descended but not into the Pyre Room); while flying it does not attack (except Talos and Seraph the Patient) and uses its variant's special action each turn. In the final wave it lands on the bottom floor and fights as a Relentless boss without its special action; no 'Brief Respite' wave precedes it. Variants (one per run, shown on the map): Double Barrel: Constructed Explosives explode twice. | Explosive Sigil: Enemy units deal 1 damage to the front unit on death. | Plating Seal: Constructed Explosives enter with Damage Shield. Wiki: Daedalus is a first Major Boss in Monster Train. Every turn before the Relentless phase, he places a Constructed Explosive on the train. He is featured in the following Ring 3 combats: • Daedalus, the Professor: Double Barrel • Daedalus, the Professor: Explosive Sigil • Daedalus, the Professor: Plating Seal

enemies.name: Talos, the Architect
enemies.pattern: Major boss: starts 'flying' beside one floor, moves to a different floor every turn and can be hit there by units/spells (always behind other enemies, cannot be moved within the floor, can be Ascended/Descended but not into the Pyre Room); while flying it does not attack (except Talos and Seraph the Patient) and uses its variant's special action each turn. In the final wave it lands on the bottom floor and fights as a Relentless boss without its special action; no 'Brief Respite' wave precedes it. Variants (one per run, shown on the map): Empowering Offense: Enemy units enter with Rage 2. Talos attacks every turn and gains Armor on Slay. | Protective Sin: Enemy units enter with Armor 5. Talos attacks every turn and pushes attacked units back. | Soul Sucker: Friendly units enter with Sap 1. Talos attacks every turn and applies Dazed on Strike. Wiki: Talos, the Architect is one of the 2 first Major Bosses in Monster Train, who can appear in Ring 3. Unlike most other Major bosses, she attacks before the Relentless phase, with varying effects based on the combat. She is featured in the following Ring 3 combats: • Talos, the Architect: Empowering Offense • Talos, the Architect: Protective Sin • Talos, the Architect: Soul Sucker
